services.name: Website chat assistant
services.summary: Website chat bot that plugs into the client's existing website and workflow to answer routine questions from approved business information and route visitors to booking.
features: Answers routine visitor questions from approved business information
Directs visitors to existing booking pages
Passes questions it cannot answer or sensitive enquiries to staff
services.source: Alpine Wave/DECISIONS.md "What we're building" (2026-10-01); website/components/Home.jsx lines 714-736, 1081-1090

services.name: Telephone / phone assistant
services.summary: 24/7 telephone assistant that answers phone calls, handles high call volumes during morning rushes, answers routine questions, takes after-hours enquiries, and provides warm transfers.
features: Answers calls 24/7 including morning rushes and holidays
Parallel call handling so callers do not get busy signals or voicemail
Natural phone conversations without press-1 menus
After-hours enquiry capture with details waiting for staff in morning
Staff alerts by text and email with call summaries and transcripts
Warm call transfer to counter phone with quick briefing first (where phone setup allows)
Local BC area code numbers (236, 250, 604) or call forwarding from existing line
services.source: Alpine Wave/DECISIONS.md "What we're building" (2026-10-01); website/components/Home.jsx lines 690-713, 739-760, 1058-1062, 1081-1113

services.name: Full website build
services.summary: Full website build offered as an upsell.

offer_tiers.name: The way in
offer_tiers.headline: A demo built from your own website
offer_tiers.lede: Nothing to set up. We read your public website and build a demo assistant from what you've already published. You get a private link to try it.
bullet_points: Answers questions using your own published info
No passwords, logins or system access
Try it yourself and show your staff
Nothing goes on your site unless you say so
offer_tiers.starting_rule: Every business starts at Tier 1. We never ask for passwords or system access up front. First you see a demo built from your own website.

offer_tiers.name: Prove it
offer_tiers.headline: 7-day shadow trial & report
offer_tiers.lede: Your staff still answer first. If nobody picks up, day or night, the assistant does. Every call it answers and every website chat is recorded, so the report shows what you're missing.
bullet_points: Missed and after-hours calls answered by the assistant
Website chats logged, including which suggestions visitors tap
Callers hear a short recording notice
Day-7 report: what came in, what was missed, what it would have caught
offer_tiers.notes: Shows you exactly what you're missing. You decide from there.

offer_tiers.name: Full partner
offer_tiers.headline: Connected to how you work
offer_tiers.lede: Once you trust it. We connect the assistant to your stock, bookings and email so it can do more than answer questions.
bullet_points: Bookings straight into your calendar or booking tool
Email enquiries answered or sorted for your team
Full-time cover, with warm transfers to your front desk
offer_tiers.prerequisites: Tier 3 connections are checked against your systems before we quote. Call transfer and system connections depend on your phone and booking setup.

website_chat.state: Answers from Alpine Wave's approved information
website_chat.description: The website chat answers using Alpine Wave's approved information, through either prepared answers or a model-enabled path. Context stays in open browser memory (latest 16 messages); refreshing clears chat. It does not store transcripts or connect to staff inboxes, bookings, payments, or live inventory.

phone_assistant.state: Being set up, not yet answering calls
phone_assistant.description: Telephone assistant is part of Alpine Wave's planned service. Phone number (236) 205-7030 is established, but the assistant is still being set up and has not been verified as answering calls. The interactive speech sample on the website is a scripted illustration.
phone_assistant.limits: Alpine Wave's own phone assistant on (236) 205-7030 cannot book, take payments, arrange callbacks, or transfer calls, nor commit to free trials. It must not claim a call was transferred, a callback arranged, or details passed on. (Client phone assistants can offer warm transfers where the phone setup allows; see services[1].)

handoff_topics.reason: Pricing is not confirmed and must be scoped based on website, channels, and connections.
handoff_topics.route: Speak with Alpine Wave team / phone / email inquiry.

handoff_topics.reason: Setup timelines depend on business requirements, site platform, and required connections.
handoff_topics.route: Agreed after reviewing website and business information.

handoff_topics.reason: Specific website, booking tool, and POS integrations must be verified against client setup before quoting.

handoff_topics.topic: Large group bookings and custom packages (Client workflows)
handoff_topics.reason: Groups of 10 or more, corporate packages, and custom catering require management review and cannot be quoted automatically.

when_unsure.guarantee: No assistant can promise it will never be wrong. Alpine Wave's assistants answer only from the business's approved information. When an assistant is not certain, it says so and hands the question to a person instead of guessing.
when_unsure.website_chat: Says it is not sure and offers to redirect the visitor to a person. For Alpine Wave's current website chat, which is not connected to staff inboxes, that means giving the visitor Alpine Wave's phone number or email address.
when_unsure.phone_assistant: For client phone assistants, says it is not sure and offers to take a message for staff; a warm transfer is offered where the phone setup allows. This does not describe Alpine Wave's own phone assistant.

client_assistant.business_information: The client's assistant answers questions about that business's own prices, opening hours and policies from its approved information. If a detail is missing, it says it is not sure and hands the question to a person as described in when_unsure. It never invents a price or opening hours.
client_assistant.live_stock: Live stock and availability can be checked only once the assistant is connected to the business's systems in Tier 3 (Full partner), subject to the system checks in offer_tiers[2]. During the free demo and 7-day trial, it cannot check live stock; it says so and directs the customer to the business itself.
client_assistant.bookings: Before connection, the assistant directs customers to the business's existing booking pages. Once connected to the business's calendar or booking tool in Tier 3, bookings go straight into that system. Connections depend on the business's setup and are checked before quoting.
client_assistant.customer_contacts: The client's customers are directed to that business's own phone, email, booking pages or staff, never to Alpine Wave. Alpine Wave's phone and email are only for people asking about Alpine Wave.
client_assistant.scope: This block describes assistants supplied to client businesses. The current-channel limits in not_offered[*] and status.* describe Alpine Wave's own website chat and phone, not the capabilities a client buys. General rules there about approved information, no guessing, no up-front system access and client approval still apply to client assistants.
